sources.title: ATO: Tax invoices, including eInvoicing and recipient-created tax invoices
sources.fact: Reviewed by Ryan Duguid on 24 September 2026 (page last updated 18 September 2026): tax invoice requirements by sale value, eInvoices issued under the A-NZ Peppol specification treated as intended to be tax invoices, and the conditions and issuer checks for recipient-created tax invoices. Thresholds and time limits are read from the page at use time, not from this record.

sources.title: ASD's ACSC: Preventing business email compromise
sources.fact: Read 26 September 2026. Recommends an approval process for requests to change payment details or make a large transfer, and verifying such a request by calling the sender on a known and verified phone number, not one given in the email. No legal rule, rate or threshold is adopted from this record.
sources.limitations: Guidance for small and medium businesses, not law. The firm's own payment approval policy governs. The automated refresh could not retrieve the page on 26 September 2026 (connection closed); it opened normally in a browser.
